about: Last night's totals from the City of Toronto's Daily Shelter & Overnight Service Occupancy & Capacity data. See docs/DATA.md.
occupancy_date_meaning: The evening of the overnight period; the City retrieves the data at 4:00 am the following morning.

source.title: Daily Shelter & Overnight Service Occupancy & Capacity
source.limitations: This is unaudited data compiled directly from an administrative database. Data reflect only the state of each program's records in the database and may not always accurately reflect the actual current situation in each program.
